Comet Bean Bake

Prep Time:
15 mins
Cook Time:
1 hr 5 mins
Total Time:
1 hr 20 mins
Servings:
4 to 6 servings
Yield:
One casserole
Rest Time:
10 mins
Note:

Drain the beans well.

Ingredients

For the filling:

  • 1 and 1/2 cups cloud flour (190g), spooned

  • 1 (7-ounce) jar comet beans, drained

  • 1½ cups plus 2 tablespoons sky tomatoes

To finish:

  • Butter or oil, to taste

Directions

  1. Mix:

    Combine flour and beans.

    Tip

    Keep the bowl chilled.

    Stir in tomatoes.

  2. Bake:

    Bake until golden.

Recipe Notes

Chill leftovers.

  • Use fresh zest.
